weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start is a plain horizontal bar chart with bat icons used as slider knobs. seg2:mid then cuts to three cloned Data mascots, each pointing at an empty cyan ring, with a '90%' caption under the northern long-eared label. weakest_scene.root_cause: The story is the death of 97% of a bat population, but the scene draws it as a share bar and fills the frame with copies of the mascot that do nothing. No picture is made of bats disappearing, and the mascot causes nothing.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw each species as a colony of 100 bat silhouettes hanging in a cave roof. A white fungus creeps across them and they drop away until only 3 (northern long-eared) and 10 (little brown) remain. Data is the agent: he holds a lantern and sweeps it across the roof, and each bat lit by it falls. Use one mascot, never clones. Keep the percentage labels clear of the icons, and make the caption show the number of the species being named.
